text: Then Joshua son of Nun sent two men out from Shittim secretly as spies, saying, Go, look over the land, especially Jericho. So they went and came to the house of a prostitute named Rahab, and lodged there.
The king of Jericho was told, Look, some men of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.
So the king of Jericho sent word to Rahab: Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to spy out the whole land.
But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them, and she said, Yes, the men did come to me, but I did not know where they were from.
About the time the gate was to be shut, at dark, the men went out; I don't know which way they went. Chase after them quickly, and you will catch them.
But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them among stalks of flax she had laid out there.
So the king's men chased after them on the road toward the Jordan, as far as the fords, and as soon as they had gone out, the gate was shut behind them.
Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up to them on the roof.
And she said to the men, I know that the LORD has given you this land, and that dread of you has fallen on us, and that all who live in this country are melting in fear before you.

For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you devoted to destruction.
When we heard it, our hearts melted, and everyone lost courage because of you, for the LORD your God is God in heaven above and on earth below.
Now then, please swear to me by the LORD that you will show kindness to my family, as I have shown kindness to you, and give me a sure sign,
that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and save us from death.
The men answered her, Our lives for yours, if you do not tell what we are doing; and when the LORD gives us the land, we will deal kindly and faithfully with you.
Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was built into the city wall, and she lived in the wall itself.
She told them, Go to the hill country, or the pursuers will find you; hide yourselves there three days until they return, and then go on your way.
The men said to her, We will be free from this oath you made us swear

unless, when we come into the land, you tie this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you gather your father, mother, brothers, and all your father's household into your house.

If anyone goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be innocent; but if a hand is laid on anyone who is with you in the house, his blood will be on our heads.
But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.
She replied, Let it be as you say. Then she sent them away, and they left; and she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
They went into the hill country and stayed there three days until the pursuers had returned, having searched all along the road without finding them.
Then the two men came back down from the hills, crossed over, and came to Joshua son of Nun, and told him everything that had happened to them.
They said to Joshua, Truly the LORD has given the whole land into our hands; indeed, all the people of the land are melting in fear because of us.
